_comment: PRIOR-RESIDUAL CENSUS INC-3 (docs/SPEC_prior_residual_census.md) -- the
CORROBORATION arm.  Extends _ft63_prires_on.json; the ONLY delta is
network.prior_residual_corroborate (plus the run paths).
WHY THIS IS A v1 DELIVERABLE AND NOT A CYCLE-FOUR ONE: D5 spent THREE field
iterations before anyone joined its flags to raw-observable evidence, and that
join is what revealed its population to be a persistent MODEL ERROR rather than
slips -- 2.1 % of D5 resets showed a raw MW/GF step against 95 % on the same
run's known-discontinuity control, and v3 suppressed 97.3 % of trips by
requiring positive evidence.  This card ships the contingency table in cycle ONE
for every family it touches, so that mistake cannot be repeated per family.
THE B-CELL is the number that matters: rows flagged above report_sigma for which
the raw observable was MEASURED and did NOT move.  On the DD family it was 97 %.
A large b-cell on cb or rxcb says the same thing it said for D5 -- the flags are
model tension, not events -- and that verdict is the design input to the
SUCCESSOR response card, which this one deliberately does not write.
network.cycle_slip.gap_instrument is already ON in this lineage; the loader
would AUTO-ARM it with a WARN otherwise, because without it the slip-QC
qualification pass never runs and every contingency cell lands in the
'no_evidence' column.  mw_lli_corroborate is deliberately NOT touched: it is a
DECISION card and would perturb the very population being measured.
JOIN SEMANTICS, so the table is read correctly:
* pl   -- the (station, satellite) verdict directly;
* zwd, rxcb -- RECEIVER-level quantities with no satellite, so the verdict is
OR-ed over that station's satellites ('did anything at this station step?');
* pb, cb -- SHARED, no station, so OR-ed over the stations that measured that
satellite this epoch.
In every case Stepped dominates Flat dominates NoEvidence: absence of evidence
is never evidence of a slip and never evidence of its absence either.
Grade on a CONVERGED WARM window -- see the ON arm's convergence-hygiene note.
